- `GET /{id}` — Retrieve data for a specific ID.

- `GET /company/{companyId}/{companyId}` — Retrieve data based on a company ID.

- `GET /solutions/{solutionId}/{solutionId}` — Retrieve data based on a solution ID.
- `GET /templates/{templateId}` — Fetch details for a specific template.
- `GET /v3/company/details` — Get detailed information about a company.
- `HEAD /{id}` — Check the existence of an item by ID.
- `HEAD /company/{companyId}` — Check the existence of a company.
- `HEAD /explore/mcp-servers` — Check the existence of an MCP server.
- `HEAD /product/{productId}` — Check the existence of a product.
- `HEAD /solutions/{solutionId}` — Check the existence of a solution.

### Data Write (3)

- `POST /webevents/visitwebpage` — Record a user's visit to a specific webpage for analytics.

### Realtime (1)
